response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience in embedded networking security, Linux kernel modifications, or security features like MACsec, 802.1X, or encryption technologies required for the role. Their expertise is primarily in web development, mobile apps, and general software engineering, with no mention of embedded firmware, switch chip knowledge, or hardware control. While they meet the mid-seniority requirement and have strong C/C++ experience, their background does not align closely enough with the core responsibilities of this embedded networking security role.
strengths: Strong software development experience with C/C++ and Linux
Proven track record in full-stack and embedded systems development
Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new technologies quickly
concerns: No direct experience with embedded networking firmware or LAN-switch products
No mention of security technologies (e.g., MACsec, 802.1X, encryption) or relevant networking protocols
Lacks experience with chip-vendor SDKs or hardware control for embedded devices
